jobs.name: needs-input-sla-probe-emit
jobs.prompt:
Run the WEEKLY Frank A3 digest emit sweep. Execute exactly: python3 /home/frank/.hermes/agent-hooks/needs-input-sla-probe.py --weekly --emit --heartbeat /tmp/needs-input-sla-probe.heartbeat

Report what happened: exit code, stdout/stderr, whether the weekly digest card was created or reused, and the ISO week. This runs WEEKLY (Monday 08:00 UTC) across all boards (jarvis-os, sycode-trading, upero), minting ONE 'FRANK A3 WEEKLY DIGEST (YYYY-WW)' card per ISO week (idempotency key frank-a3-weekly-digest-<ISO-week>) grouped by decision-type with APPROVE/DEFER/CLOSE triage. If exit != 0, report the error clearly.

jobs.name: needs-input-sla-probe-liveness
jobs.prompt:
Run the needs_input SLA probe liveness monitor. Execute exactly: python3 /home/frank/.hermes/agent-hooks/needs-input-sla-probe-liveness.py --heartbeat /tmp/needs-input-sla-probe.heartbeat

The probe emit is now WEEKLY (Monday 08:00 UTC) so the monitor's default max-age is 8 days (192h) — a healthy week between digestives reports OK. If exit code is 0: report OK and the last sweep age. If exit code is 1: report ALARM with the missing-or-stale heartbeat details (probe has not emitted in >8 days). This runs every 7 hours. If exit != 0, escalate clearly.
